name: Hono API
rationale: Hono APIs drift into route-handler monoliths unless transport parsing, middleware, service orchestration, and runtime-specific concerns remain separated.

directories.purpose: Hono route registration and transport parsing.
Use-case and workflow orchestration called by routes.

fileRules.name: Hono Thin Route Files
fileRules.rule: Hono route files should not own workflow orchestration, persistence, validation, and response shaping in one large handler.
fileRules.trigger: A route/controller file exceeds the route-thinness threshold.
fileRules.recommendation: Keep Hono handlers transport-focused and delegate workflows to src/server/services modules.
fileRules.goodExample: src/server/routes/users.ts validates input then calls src/server/services/userService.ts.
fileRules.badExample: A route file owns auth, validation, database queries, business rules, and response mapping.

moduleBoundaries: Routes parse transport input and call services/use-cases.
Services own workflow decisions and call repositories or platform adapters.
Runtime-specific Hono concerns should not leak into domain modules.
testingExpectations: Add handler tests around request/response behavior and service tests around workflow rules.
agentInstructions: Do not put complete workflows into Hono route callbacks; create service modules before adding complex endpoints.
